b2-23-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Old Tenement
b2-23-01.scenario: At dusk in the streets of Buda, Medve Gábor points at an old apartment building and asks you, Bébé, why it looks so familiar.
b2-23-01.prompt: Tell Medve why the building looks familiar.
cues: Say that you passed it often
b2-23-01.target: Ez az a bérház, amely mellett sokszor elmentünk.
b2-23-01.english: This is the apartment building that we walked past many times.
b2-23-01.canDo: I can link two clauses with amely or aki and a postposition (amely mellett, amely által, akik között)

b2-23-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The World of the Courtyard
b2-23-02.scenario: In the inner courtyard, Medve Gábor asks you, Bébé, what makes this place special.
b2-23-02.prompt: Tell Medve what kind of world this courtyard is.
cues: Say what kind of world it is
Say what meets in its courtyard
b2-23-02.target: Ez egy olyan világ, amelynek udvarán a múlt és a jelen találkozik.
b2-23-02.english: This is a world in whose courtyard the past and the present meet.
b2-23-02.canDo: I can make a relative phrase with a possessed noun (amelynek udvarán, amelynek a tetején)

b2-23-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Protection Means
b2-23-03.scenario: While walking, Bébé asks you, Medve Gábor, what the protection of old buildings really means.
b2-23-03.prompt: Tell Bébé what monument protection means.
cues: Say what it is not only
b2-23-03.target: A műemlékvédelem nem csak a téglákról szól, hanem az emlékekről is.
b2-23-03.english: Monument protection is not only about the bricks, but also about the memories.
b2-23-03.canDo: I can talk about renovation, remodelling and listed buildings (felújítás, átépítés, műemlék)

b2-23-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The People of the House
b2-23-04.scenario: Under the gas lamps, Medve Gábor asks you, Bébé, how the people of these old houses live.
b2-23-04.prompt: Tell Medve how the people of these houses live.
b2-23-04.target: Az emberek, akikkel a lépcsőházban találkozunk, nyugodtan élnek.
b2-23-04.english: The people we meet in the stairwell live peacefully.
b2-23-04.canDo: I can talk about neighbours with akikkel, akik között, akikre and akiknek

b2-23-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What the City Needs
b2-23-05.scenario: At the end of the walk, Medve Gábor asks you, Bébé, what kind of city you want.
b2-23-05.prompt: Tell Medve what kind of city you want.
b2-23-05.target: Olyan városra van szükség, amelynek udvarain van csend.
b2-23-05.english: What is needed is a city in whose courtyards there is quiet.
b2-23-05.canDo: I can present a short proposal with a longer relative clause (egy olyan terv, amelynek …)

b2-23-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Quiet of the Courtyard
b2-23-consolidation.scenario: Standing in the courtyard, Medve Gábor asks you, Bébé, why the quiet here feels different.
b2-23-consolidation.prompt: Tell Medve what is different about the quiet here.
cues: Say how its quiet differs from the street
b2-23-consolidation.target: Ez az az udvar, amelynek csendje más, mint az utca csendje.
b2-23-consolidation.english: This is the courtyard whose quiet is different from the quiet of the street.
b2-23-consolidation.canDo: I can use amely or aki with a postposition (amely mellett, amely által, akik között)
